scope: Manual visual spotcheck; two viewports and one trusted populated state per profile. Not comprehensive accessibility or production certification.

states_reviewed: Three saved notes, including one long unbroken title; editor open on an existing note; focused title textbox.
observations: Desktop and mobile screenshots show readable labels, note text, and controls, with no observed overlap or clipped note content.
The long unbroken title wraps inside its note card at both viewports.
Mobile action buttons stack within the viewport; vertical scrolling is expected for the populated list.
The title textbox has a distinct blue focus outline while unfocused controls do not have that outline.
No page errors were captured; document scroll width equals viewport width at both sizes.

focus_source_review.basis: Read the accepted CSS and JavaScript as data and observed the focused title textbox in both screenshots. This was not a pixel-by-pixel focused/unfocused comparison of every control.

limitations: One accepted notes artifact, two Chromium viewports, and a fixed populated/editing state were reviewed.
No screen reader, high contrast mode, zoom sweep, alternate browser, or exhaustive interaction-state review was performed.
This manual spotcheck supplements the registered automated suite; it is not WCAG conformance certification or evidence of universal production readiness.
Task-list and inventory artifacts were not included in this review because their evaluated candidates had not qualified for release at capture time.
